command_line:
set -eu
Rscript - "/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/80272749/inputs/dataset_780ca9f5-aeb1-4cc9-99e8-a08c124a6c7f.dat" <<'RS'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
infile <- args[[1]]
d <- read.csv(infile, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
required <- c("DishNumber", "StrainNumber", "Ratio", "Replicate", "Area")
if (!all(required %in% names(d))) stop("Required columns are missing")
keep <- d$StrainNumber %in% c("287", "98", "287_98")
m <- d[keep, , drop = FALSE]
p <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(m))
p[m$StrainNumber == "287"] <- 1
p[m$StrainNumber == "98"] <- 0
mix <- m$StrainNumber == "287_98"
parts <- strsplit(m$Ratio[mix], ":", fixed = TRUE)
if (any(lengths(parts) != 2L)) stop("Invalid mixture ratio")
a <- as.numeric(vapply(parts, `[[`, character(1), 1L))
b <- as.numeric(vapply(parts, `[[`, character(1), 2L))
p[mix] <- a / (a + b)
fitdat <- data.frame(Area = as.numeric(m$Area), p = p)
fitdat <- fitdat[complete.cases(fitdat), , drop = FALSE]
if (nrow(fitdat) != nrow(m)) stop("Missing/non-numeric model values")
if (nrow(fitdat) != 42L) stop(sprintf("Unexpected fitted row count: %d", nrow(fitdat)))
if (min(fitdat$p) != 0 || max(fitdat$p) != 1) stop("Expected observed endpoints 0 and 1")
models <- list(
  quadratic = lm(Area ~ p + I(p^2), data = fitdat),
  cubic = lm(Area ~ p + I(p^2) + I(p^3), data = fitdat),
  natural_spline_df4 = lm(Area ~ splines::ns(p, df = 4), data = fitdat)
)
nobs_each <- vapply(models, nobs, numeric(1))
if (length(unique(nobs_each)) != 1L) stop("Models used different row counts")
aics <- vapply(models, AIC, numeric(1))
adjr2 <- vapply(models, function(z) summary(z)$adj.r.squared, numeric(1))
rmse <- vapply(models, function(z) sqrt(mean(residuals(z)^2)), numeric(1))
best_name <- names(which.min(aics))
best <- models[[best_name]]
lo <- min(fitdat$p)
hi <- max(fitdat$p)
pred1 <- function(x) as.numeric(predict(best, newdata = data.frame(p = x)))
grid <- seq(lo, hi, length.out = 10001L)
gy <- pred1(grid)
interior <- which(gy[2:(length(gy)-1L)] >= gy[1:(length(gy)-2L)] &
                  gy[2:(length(gy)-1L)] >= gy[3:length(gy)]) + 1L
cand_p <- c(lo, hi)
for (i in interior) {
  op <- optimize(function(x) -pred1(x), interval = c(grid[i-1L], grid[i+1L]),
                 tol = .Machine$double.eps^0.25)
  cand_p <- c(cand_p, op$minimum)
}
cand_y <- pred1(cand_p)
j <- which.max(cand_y)
opt_p <- cand_p[j]
max_area <- cand_y[j]
con <- file("result.tsv", open = "wt")
writeLines("key	value", con)
emit <- function(k, v) writeLines(paste(k, v, sep = "	"), con)
emit("analysis_engine", paste0("R ", getRversion()))
emit("response", "Area")
emit("predictor", "proportion_strain_287")
emit("row_scope", "287_98 mixtures plus pure 287 and pure 98 endpoints")
emit("replicate_handling", "raw dish-level observations")
emit("n_fitted", nrow(fitdat))
emit("domain_min", format(lo, digits = 15, scientific = FALSE))
emit("domain_max", format(hi, digits = 15, scientific = FALSE))
emit("quadratic_formula", "Area ~ p + I(p^2)")
emit("cubic_formula", "Area ~ p + I(p^2) + I(p^3)")
emit("natural_spline_formula", "Area ~ splines::ns(p, df=4)")
for (nm in names(models)) {
  emit(paste0("AIC_", nm), format(aics[[nm]], digits = 15))
  emit(paste0("adjusted_R2_", nm), format(adjr2[[nm]], digits = 15))
  emit(paste0("RMSE_", nm), format(rmse[[nm]], digits = 15))
  emit(paste0("nobs_", nm), nobs_each[[nm]])
}
emit("selection_metric", "minimum_AIC")
emit("best_model", best_name)
emit("optimal_frequency", format(opt_p, digits = 15, scientific = FALSE))
emit("maximum_predicted_area", format(max_area, digits = 15, scientific = FALSE))
close(con)
RS
